recipes.title: Beef, Bacon & Egg Breakfast Burritos

items.i: paprika, garlic powder and onion powder
white rice, raw (cooked in 1½ cups water)
each onion powder, paprika, salt and pepper
Ole Xtreme Wellness wraps (two 6-packs — the larger size)

steps: Brown the beef with paprika, garlic powder and onion powder.
Cook the rice with 1½ cups water.
Cook the chopped beef bacon; when it's almost done, crack in the eggs, add pepper and scramble together.
Stir all the sauce ingredients together.
Mix the beef, bacon and eggs, then fold in the rice and sauce.
Divide among the 12 wraps and roll into burritos. Freeze or refrigerate for the week.
recipes.notes: Macros per burrito as stated in the description.
